question: Mr. O starts from Point L and drives 3 km towards the south. He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 4 km. He then takes a left turn and drives 4 km. He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point M. How far (shortest distance) and towards which direction should he drive in order to reach Point L again? (All turns are 90 degree turns only unless specified.)
solution:
Given: 

Mr. O starts from Point L and drives 3 km towards the south.

He then takes a left turn, drives 3 km, turns right and drives 4 km.

He then takes a left turn and drives 4 km.

He takes a final left turn, drives 7 km and stops at Point M.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/539559cd3b2c2e2fb2ecbf5101a9bddfdf74a8198e0a62fee5f764ad791c7ae0.png] 

Thus, Mr. O should drive 7 km (3 km + 4 km) in the west direction in order to reach Point L again.

Hence, **"Option 1"** is the correct answer.
